description: CFG-207: legacy discovery.cache.max_entries divergence — Python does not read the key (n/a); Go/Rust honor 0 as unbounded and coerce invalid/negative/empty/unset to 64
note: Python caps the jwks and discovery caches together and never reads DISCO_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES, so it is n/a here (per the config.md registry n/a convention: the language does not read the key today). Only go/rust cap the discovery cache independently and honor 0 as the unbounded escape hatch. Strict mode harmonizes 0 to unbounded everywhere — the discovery-cache mirror of CFG-110/CFG-202.
